target_customer: Independent event organizers, venues and cultural spaces
problem: Small art, music and activist spaces lack revenue tools; ticket checkout can upsell memberships.
business_model: Fees on memberships, donations and tickets

founders.name: Joe Ahearn
founders.background_notes: Per Launch HN post, Joe and Kunal started The Silent Barn; Joe and Martha ran Showpaper.

founders.name: Kunal Gupta
founders.background_notes: Named in Launch HN post May 2019 as co-founder (first name only in post; surname from an indexical.org event listing title).

founders.name: Martha
founders.background_notes: Surname not given in the Launch HN post.

competitors.name: Eventbrite
competitors.what: Ticketing platform; Withfriends integrated with it rather than competing head on

technical_complexity.rationale: Ticketing and membership checkout with POS and Eventbrite integrations; standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Member lists create some lock-in but features were copyable by ticketing platforms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy or purchase found; company stayed tiny (team of 2 on YC page).

market_need_then: Launch HN May 2019 reported 85+ small businesses, 5,500 members, about 40 percent added revenue for customers and about $6k MRR.

rebrands.why: Not stated in any source found.

brand_strength.rationale: Small community brand with organizer meetups; rename reason unknown and Pools collides with a UK betting brand.

pivots.from: Membership upsell for small businesses incl. native ticketing
pivots.to: Event discovery, ticketing and memberships platform for DIY event organizers
pivots.why: Not stated; difference between 2019 Launch HN and current Pools site.

outcome_analysis: Withfriends launched with real early traction among NYC independent venues, led by founders who ran venues themselves. It later rebranded to Pools and remains active but with a team of two on YC, suggesting a niche market and slow growth. Funding found is only a small seed, so scale has been limited; the failure factor is a judgment from team size, not a stated cause.
notes: Funding unverified: Bouncewatch lists $150K seed March 2019 (YC) and a 2018 seed of unknown amount; Pitchbook about $257K total. No round recorded since only aggregators. Founding year 2017 per YC (Pitchbook says 2015, Bouncewatch 2016). Launch HN post is a blog repost of the original thread. Eventbrite listed as an integration partner, not a rival; no other dated competitor found.
